supersedes: cl_rd_raw_accounting_discriminator_v1 (preserved; determination unchanged, reopening condition broadened per sci-package LOW)
determination: FAIL at present: no measured host-expenditure endpoint; strict matching of realized host-model consumption across arms (incl. learning overhead) not demonstrated. CL-RD-RAW acquisition remains stopped until a reopening condition is witnessed.
reopening_conditions_any_of: User supplies a measured per-call host expenditure source for the codex/gpt-6.1-sol route (billing export or metered API with recorded cost and a numeric spend cap); then re-run this discriminator.

OR a justified alternative primary resource endpoint (spec section 11) is proposed in a hashed SPEC and sol-high reviewed >=90, demonstrating prospectively that every other material resource - including realized host-model tokens (input/cached/output/reasoning), retries, routing/caching differences, and all learning-overhead calls - is measured per arm or demonstrably strictly matched, with fixed baselines receiving corresponding useful search opportunities. Equal call counts/efforts/prompt budgets alone do not establish matching; token list-price valuation is not measured expenditure.
note: Reopening permits a new feasibility assessment only; it does not certify C9 or authorize outcome acquisition before partition/processing witnesses (CL-RD-RAW-FEASIBILITY-01 steps 1-4) and G2 review >=90.
